prompt: how do large language models like ChatGPT work

plan.title: How ChatGPT Really Works
plan.description: Large language models like ChatGPT write by predicting one word at a time. Learn how this simple trick, repeated at huge scale, produces fluent answers.

beats.narration: ChatGPT doesn't actually know what it's going to say. It just guesses the next word, over and over.

props.text: It just guesses the next word.

beats.narration: It learned by reading enormous amounts of text, spotting patterns in how words follow each other, until its guesses became remarkably good.
Each word it picks becomes part of the question for the next. Fluent answers are just predictions, chained together.

props.text: Fluent answers are predictions, chained together.
